resources.string: Rings at the end of a rest while Belay is not on screen
Exercise, set and timers of the open session

If you turn it on in Settings › Health Connect, Belay adds your finished sessions (start and end) and your weigh-ins to Health Connect. It reads other apps’ workouts only so a session is not counted twice, and your weigh-ins only if you turn on their import: they then sync with your Belay instance. No other Health Connect data leaves this phone.
